hook.name: DynamicFeeHook
hook.description: Adjusts LP fees dynamically based on per-swap volume thresholds, calling updateDynamicLPFee() on every swap. Implements a price-deviation circuit breaker that locks the fee when price moves outside configurable bounds, caps fee increases per block, enforces a minimum number of blocks at elevated fees for MEV protection, and provides an owner-controlled emergency mode that overrides fees globally.
